scope: Weeks 8-10 of the plan. Week 7 (generative arm on task 1) follows configs/s7_preregistration.json; this file fixes the rest before any real result exists.

generative_dose.source: SPR mean of the selected generator (K and N of the S7 main evaluation)
generative_dose.comparison: proton gamma 2%/2mm of G against R3 seed 0 from S6, paired two-sided Wilcoxon
generative_dose.expectation: no significant difference (the generator's mean equals the Bayes act at best)

task2_generative.eta: the eta selected on task 1 (no new selection)

s9_task2.rule: configs/s4_preregistration.json applied unchanged to the task-2 development cases (one seed)
s9_task2.spectra: configs/s3_preregistration.json applied unchanged to the R1 (L1 in HU) out-of-fold predictions of task 2
s9_task2.replication: task 2 replicates task 1 when both pre-registered verdicts are identical

s9_tomography.domain: sparse-view parallel-beam CT on the reference CTs of the task-1 development cases
s9_tomography.evaluation: central 16 slices of every task-1 development case, line integrals at the 180 held-out angles, in mm of water
s9_tomography.expectation: g is the identity, so l2 is already the Bayes act for squared line-integral loss; a gain of l2_proj tests Result A (spectral weighting under finite capacity) in isolation

s9_precipitation.reason: the plan schedules the basin-rainfall domain only if S6 finishes without delay, and it needs an external gauge/radar dataset that this repository does not provide; it is left to a later version rather than replaced by synthetic data

s10_ablations.test: paired two-sided Wilcoxon of each listed comparison, Holm within each family; median paired difference with a 95 % bootstrap interval
s10_ablations.centers: R5 and R6 of S4 seed 0 are the centre runs (reused when their checkpoints match)

s10_registration.alternative: IMPACT-registered CTs (Boussot et al., 2025; huggingface.co/datasets/VBoussot/synthrad2025-impact-registration), arranged in the SynthRAD2025 layout under SCT_IMPACT_ROOT
s10_registration.cases: task-1 development cases with an IMPACT CT on the same grid
s10_registration.matrix: train on Elastix (S4 R3 seed 0) or IMPACT, test against the Elastix or the IMPACT reference CT
s10_registration.note: without SCT_IMPACT_ROOT this part is reported as not run
